care_continuity: National isolation/CTE stock: 937; the three printed provincial stocks (429+450+16) leave 42 unattributed. No national confirmed/suspect split.
Ituri: 429 patients at a printed 41%, 59 critical; 104 admissions, 68 exits, 12 recoveries.

Nord-Kivu (page 7): 450 hospitalized (62 children under five), 2 critical; 359 in CTE/CT for 410 beds (printed 87.6%), suspects 180/192 (93.8%) and confirmed 179/218 (82.1%); 91 in facilities that are not CTE/CT (20.2%). 359+91=450 reconciles. The 87.6% is a CTE/CT-only rate and the census exceeds the bed count, so no all-census occupancy is inferred. Data completeness 71% (Beni, Musienene and Kalunguta missing). Hot meals went to 181 confirmed and 216 suspects, which do not match the 179/180 split; not used.
Tshopo: 16 patients for 36 beds (44.4%); 2 suspect admissions, 3 exits and 1 recovery; 7 patients lost to follow-up, 6 of them confirmed cases from Bafwasende.
Haut-Uele and Bas-Uele: no care panel printed this edition.
challenges: Contacts 25164/32744 (76.9%), down from 80.0% and below the 95% threshold; 7580 unseen (23.1%). Follow-up is weakest in Ituri (69.9%), notably Bunia 26.0% (936/3599), and in Nord-Kivu (78.6%). No provincial counts are printed.

Alerts: 3241 of 3244 verified (99.9%), 474 validated as suspects, 468 investigated (98.7%) and 232 transferred (printed 49.6%, which is over the 468 investigated). The 3 alerts to clarify are live Haut-Uele alerts and the 6 suspects not investigated are all in Ituri (5 Nyankunde, 1 Mongbwalu); Sud-Ubangi prints ND.

PoE/PoC completeness 111/120 (92.5%): Sud-Kivu 55.6% (5/9), with Kalundu Port SNCC and Baraka lacking isolation (the sentence is truncated in the source); Nord-Kivu down to 90.5% (19/21), the Butuhe PoC closed since the 26 September security incident, the Kyavinyonge PoE not reporting, and insecurity on the Butembo axis, consumable stock-outs and no dedicated ambulance persisting; Ituri lacks supervision mobility at Rwampara, Nizi and Bunia, provider pay is late, the Mandima PoCs need an ambulance, traveller flow at Mudzi Bala was disrupted by a drivers' protest and the Avakubi PoC is non-functional for insecurity; Haut-Uele's Doko PoE (no scheduled flight) and Gossamu PoC (poor connection) did not report; Bas-Uele PK12 Isiro PoC providers are on strike over non-payment and PNHF services, training, water, mobility and connectivity are lacking.

Ituri: 6 of 26 rings unopened, 12 of 29 households not decontaminated, 21 EDS failed and 16 of 67 bodies (23.9%) not swabbed; Nord-Kivu: decontamination teams attacked in the Butsili and Butanuka health areas (Beni), 10 of 16 rings unopened, 22 of 27 households not decontaminated, no household kits (0/5) and 40 EDS postponed; Tshopo short of IPC supplies and IPC-trained frontline workers, with absent families preventing swabs; Bas-Uele 16 of 20 priority facilities without functional triage, none with mattresses, 17 of 20 without 72-hour water storage and weak community death alert reporting.

Ituri: 429 patients at a printed 41% with no bed denominator, 59 critical; low capacity at Kilo, Lolwa and Biakato, blood supply short of needs (100 units received, 103 in stock), no food for 8 patients in Mandima (CT Mandima and CT Makeke), ambulance movement reporting 18/33.

Nord-Kivu: CTE/CT occupancy 359/410 (87.6%), suspect beds saturated at 93.8% (180/192) and 91 of 450 patients (20.2%) cared for outside CTE/CT; data completeness 71% (Beni, Musienene and Kalunguta missing).
Tshopo: 16 patients for 36 beds (44.4%); no food or nutrition support at the Bafwasende CT; 7 patients lost to follow-up, 6 of them confirmed cases from Bafwasende.

Bas-Uele has no ambulance, its standard CTE at HGR Buta is still under construction, nutrition support for suspects isolated in facilities is not covered and psychosocial support for its 3 confirmed cases is delayed.

Ituri's frontline-worker target remains to be redefined (the challenge prints 1120 vaccinated against a provisional 1000, while the actions keep a cumulative 1260 with no data for the day); Bas-Uele cold-chain units are not running, vaccine quantities are insufficient and funds are awaited; Tshopo has a 551-vaccinee gap between its Excel and DHIS2 databases and Bafwasende has not reported for four days; the Nord-Kivu team lacks 2 vehicles and 3 small tents, and ARKTEK vaccine transport remains to be confirmed. Vaccine logistics do not establish efficacy against Bundibugyo.

Tshopo: a 22nd frontline worker was confirmed at a Makiso-Kisangani health centre whose assessment found no triage zone, PPE or working incinerator, 2 of 16 staff vaccinated (12.5%) and a single nurse trained on Ebola. Bas-Uele: service use at HGR Ganga fell from 29.5% in June to 20.3% in September 2026 against a 60% norm.

Ituri psychosocial coverage reaches 14 of 28 affected zones (50.0%) and only 13 of the 27 latest confirmed cases (48.1%) were supported; deployment of the psychologists and psychosocial workers in training is awaited; Bas-Uele's support for its 3 confirmed cases is delayed and Tshopo's Wanie-Rukula workers remain to be trained.

Ituri community engagement reporting completeness is low (10 of 28 zones, 36%); Nord-Kivu received 562 of 650 expected community alerts (86.5%), resolved 3 of 8 incidents (37.5%) with 5 transfer refusals at the Butembo CTE unresolved, and engaged 3467 of 4750 people (73.0%).

Nord-Kivu (Beni): public order was restored at a health facility after a suspect case's resistance and decontamination teams were attacked in the Butsili and Butanuka health areas (the source prints this under Tshopo); Tshopo: threats against teams block investigations around cases 65 to 70 at Bafwasende; Ituri: the Avakubi PoC remains non-functional for insecurity.
highlights: DRC: 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 confirmed deaths as of 18 October 2026 (CFR 48.2%).

priorities: Strengthen epidemiological surveillance and contact follow-up to limit community transmission: contact follow-up fell from 80.0% to 76.9%, below the 95% threshold, and 6 suspects remain uninvestigated in Ituri (5 Nyankunde, 1 Mongbwalu).
Keep surveillance vigilance, consolidate IPC and community engagement, and deliver quality care in dedicated facilities with adequate capacity.

Deaths and recoveries move cleanly: 4561 to 4602 (+41: 30 community plus 11 intra-CTE; the cover splits the CTE deaths 6 Ituri, 4 Nord-Kivu, 1 Haut-Uele, matching Tableau 2) and 2530 to 2550 (+20: 12 Ituri, 7 Nord-Kivu, 1 Tshopo).

The 493 Ituri deaths printed as A ventiler remain unallocated: 4109 named zone deaths plus 493 close on 4602. Blank daily cells remain null; printed zeros remain zero. Nyankunde prints a zero new count and zero community deaths beside an intra-CTE death; Mutwanga prints blank new and community cells beside a zero intra-CTE cell; Wapinda prints a blank total-deaths cell, kept null.

Alerts (pages 4-5): Tableau 3 and the prose agree on 3244 alerts, 3241 verified (99.9%), 474 validated (14.6% of verified), 2767 invalidated (85.4%), 468 investigated (98.7%) and 232 transferred. Sud-Ubangi prints ND throughout; Nord-Ubangi appears as a reporting province (7 alerts) for the first time in this table. The 3 alerts to clarify are live Haut-Uele alerts and the 6 uninvestigated suspects are in Ituri, matching the key messages (5 Nyankunde, 1 Mongbwalu). The printed 49.6% transfer rate is 232/468 (over investigated), while 232/474 is 48.9%. Provincial alert counts move sharply from SR156 (Nord-Kivu 822 to 1780, Ituri 1420 to 1120); daily counts preserved as printed, not repaired.

Contacts: 76.9% is 25164/32744 (cover, prose and key messages, down from 80.0%). The prose says seven provinces transmitted but prints no provincial counts; only Ituri 69.9%, Bunia 26.0% (936/3599) and Nord-Kivu 78.6% are printed, and no other provincial value is derived. The prose cites Tableau 4, which is the PoE/PoC table.

Nord-Kivu (page 7): 450 hospitalized (62 children under five), 2 critical; 359 in CTE/CT for 410 beds (printed 87.6%), suspects 180/192 (93.8%) and confirmed 179/218 (82.1%); 91 in facilities that are not CTE/CT (20.2%). 359+91=450 reconciles. The 87.6% is a CTE/CT-only rate and the census exceeds the bed count, so no all-census occupancy is inferred. Data completeness 71% (Beni, Musienene and Kalunguta missing). Hot meals went to 181 confirmed and 216 suspects, which do not match the 179/180 split; not used.
Nord-Kivu stock flow: SR156's printed 471 plus 74 admissions minus 95 exits gives 450, the printed census.

Ituri care (page 7): 429 patients follows exactly from SR156's 393 plus 104 admissions minus 68 exits; the printed 41% is integer precision with no bed denominator and no confirmed/suspect split; none is carried. Hot meals reached 410 of 418 patients (98%), a base that differs from the 429 census. 75 children received nutritional care (11 CTE, 4 creche, 60 community).

Tshopo care (page 7): SR156's 19 plus 2 suspect admissions minus 3 exits gives 18, against the printed 16 (16/36 is the printed 44.4%). The two admissions are suspects and Tableau 2 prints no new Tshopo confirmation. 7 patients are lost to follow-up, 6 of them confirmed cases from Bafwasende (SR156: 6). Since the start, 45 confirmed cases received experimental treatment (3 MBP134, 42 remdesivir) and 481 people post-exposure prophylaxis (SR156: 44 and 464); neither is an efficacy signal. Not repaired.

Isolation: the cover 937 exceeds the three printed provincial stocks 429+450+16 by 42. Haut-Uele and Bas-Uele print no care panel this edition (SR156: 39 and 3, which also sum to 42); the 42 is left unattributed and no provincial stock is carried. No national confirmed/suspect split is printed or derived.

PoE/PoC (page 5): Tableau 4 covers Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele and the prose agrees: 6 alerts, 3 validated live suspects of which 2 transferred (66.7%; one Ituri suspect refused transfer), the other 3 Ituri alerts invalidated at secondary screening and no body intercepted. Completeness 111/120 (92.5%) and 278361 travellers sum from the provinces. The Sud-Kivu challenge sentence is truncated ('persistent., Kalundu Port SNCC et Baraka'). No case is inferred.

Laboratory (page 6): 500 samples, 97 positive (19.4%), split 67 living and 30 deceased; deceased positives match Tableau 2's community deaths in every province and every printed provincial positivity matches its counts. Tshopo (11) and Bas-Uele (12, of which 4 were sent to Isiro) were all negative.
Key messages (page 9) agree with Tableau 3 and the prose on 468/474 investigated and 6 uninvestigated in Ituri, and on contact follow-up falling from 80.0% to 76.9%.

Vaccination (pages 7-8): Ituri keeps a cumulative 1260 frontline workers vaccinated (no data for the day), while the challenge still prints 1120 vaccinated against a provisional target of 1000. Both preserved; no winner chosen. Nord-Kivu now prints a Beni zone cumulative of 322 of 7105 (4.5%), the same target SR156 used for its 192 cumulative; 192 plus SR156's 130 is 322, so the zone and provincial labels may describe the same count. Bas-Uele received 500 Ervebo doses and reaches 11.4% of its target (1500/13202). No efficacy signal against BDBV is inferred.
SMSPS (page 8): Ituri prints 13 of 27 confirmed cases supported and its challenge 13 of the 27 latest confirmed cases; 27 is SR156's Ituri daily count, not SR157's 42. Not repaired.
IPC (pages 6-7): Ituri prints 44 EDS done of 76 alerts while its challenge prints 21 EDS failed (76 - 44 = 32); both preserved.

Security (page 9): an event at a Beni health facility and the attacks on decontamination teams in the Butsili and Butanuka health areas (Beni) are printed under the heading 'A la Tshopo'; the IPC challenges place the same attacks in Nord-Kivu. Read as a heading error, not repaired.
Cover (page 1): the text layer carries white-on-white '246 Aires de sante touchees Sur 3104 (7,9%)' that does not render; no health-area footprint is promoted.

Figure 1 is an onset-date plot of 7438 confirmed cases with onset date and vital status, the same n as SR156; it is not a cumulative count and bar heights are not reconstructed. Figure 2 map legends (66 zones with cases; 22 with new cases) match Tableau 2 but the maps are not a statistical source.
PSEA (page 9): 56 of 151 zones with PSEA activities (37.1%) uses a 151-zone base that is not the 178-zone footprint denominator; not used.

Dakwa retains its explicitly disclosed facility-coordinate proxy; its health-zone boundary and model centroid are still unverified. Wapinda carries the geometry fields of the promoted SR156 row unchanged.
